summary: Flat, tree-shaded kerb mid-street; homes 13-20 m off, cars park nearby.
reasons: Cars parked along the eastern end

best_section.where: Shaded mid-block, west of the parked cars, before the bend

drivers.seclusion: Homes about 13 m south at 53 m and 19 m north at 84 m; nearest at 69 m is 35 m. Dense canopy screens the street.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with a kerbside strip under trees; cars parked at 0-55 m show room, but the lane narrows westwards.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street, near a junction at the west end.
drivers.convention: 2P Mon-Fri 7am-6pm, resident permits excepted; cars park along the kerb. No campers seen.

flags: Steep at the east end: max grade 12.2%
sun_shade: Heavy canopy over the whole section; shaded most of the day.
cannot_judge: Exact kerbside width under the canopy
